subject: Re: appointment confirmation
text: Hi there, thanks for checking in. I think Thursday at 3:30 still works well, but I just realized the community room entrance can be tricky because the side door is sometimes locked after school hours. Maybe we could meet at the main front desk instead and walk over together? That would help our newer volunteers find us without circling the building. I can bring the sign-in sheet and the donation boxes. If anything changes on your end, just reply here, and I will adjust the schedule. Looking forward to seeing everyone then! Also, please let me know if you would prefer a shorter start so we can leave time for the equipment handoff. We can always shift fifteen minutes later if that makes setup easier.
